title: Hot in. Cold out.
captions:
Hot in. Cold out. 🔥➡️❄️

It even flags when your pressures are staggered across the four corners, so you can sort it before the next session, not after. 🏁

🔗 kart-connect.com

#KartConnect #Karting #KartRacing #KartSetup #TyrePressures
